translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

content: Adamana aiku asauku nuqu.
Adamana aiku asauku misa oosana maaqimmasee akaraki marinau. Anutufa indaaru narí amana kai faiqí anaasee auqinau.
Naumoo faqaa qanda auquseenoo nifaaqooqa qima nimaqaseenoo faiqí anaasee fee qimasee nuqu ranau.
Adamafa aukuana 130 marasoofanoo mina amaaku Seetafa kambiqanau. Narí akoona fooqaafa mina amana kai marinau.
Seetana maqookari oosana araseenoo Adamafa 800 aukuana maranau. Mi kamuqoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo Adamafa maqanau.
Adamana aukuana aiqama 930 maraseenoo kuqinau.
Seetafa 105 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi Eennoosana maqanau.
Eennoosana maqoo kamuqooqari Seetafa 807 aukuana maraseenoo mi kamuqoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo maqanau.
Seetana aiqama aukuana 912 maraseenoo kuqinau.
Eennoosafa 90 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi Keennana maqanau.
Keennana maqoo kamuqooqari Eennoosafa 815 aukuana maraseenoo mi kamuqoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo maqanau.
Eennoosana aukuana aiqama moodaanaki 905 maraseenoo kuqinau.
Mina amaaku Keennafa 70 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi Maqarareerana maqanau.
Maqarareerana maqoo kamuqooqari Keennafa 840 aukuana maraseenoo mi kamuqoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo maqanau.
Keennana aukuana aiqama moodaanaki 910 maraseenoo kuqinau.
Mina amaaku Maqarareerafa 65 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi Yareedana maqanau.
Yareedana maqooqooqari 830 aukuana maraseenoo mi kamuqoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo Yareedafa maqanau.
Maqarareerana aukuana aiqama moodaanaki 895 maraseenoo kuqinau.
Mina amaaku Yaareedafa 162 aukuana maraseenoo narí amaaku Eennookana maqanau.
Eennookana maqooqooqari Yareedafa 800 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo maqanau.
Yareedana aukuana aiqama moodaanaki 962 maraseenoo kuqinau.
Mina amaaku Eennookafa 65 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi Meetuseerana maqanau.
Eennookafa 300 aukuana Anutuna aqoondikiranaki maridanoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo maqanau.
Eennookana aukuana aiqama moodaanaki 365 aukuana maranau.
Eennookafa sia kuqinau. Kaaqa Anutunara rimarufa marufanoo Anutufa kaqimma afiqasoofanoo sia sia inau.
Eennookana amaaku Meetuseerafa 187 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi Rammeekana amarana maqanau.
Rammeekana maqooqooqari mina akoofa Meetuseerafa 782 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo maqanau.
Meetuseerana aukuana aiqama moodaanaki 969 aukuana maraseenoo kuqinau.
Meetuseerana amaaku Rammeekana amarafa 82 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi maqaseenoo qinau.
Anutufa maa maqa maaqana aquraraqoofaqa maasa kadaapi ridaqa. Maa faiqifa kadaapiriranaki marunnana asooarana qimiannoo fee qimasee mina auqu Nooa nee qinau.
Nooana maqooqooqari mina akoofa Rammeekafa 595 aukuana maraseenoo akoonaiqi maanaaqa faiqi namu moomoo maqanau.
Rameekana aukuana aiqama moodaanaki 777 maraseenoo kuqinau.
Mina amaaku Nooafa 500 aukuana maraseenoo miqooqari akoonaiqi qaaramoo maqanau. Misa nuqu Seemmana faqa Qammana faqa Yafeetana faqa maqanau.
